condition_comparison.preserved_meaning: OS-015 (source identity/authority record), OS-016 (portfolio trace/state), OS-019 (evidence/continuity), and OS-022 (improvement-candidate registration/routing) offer adjacent record, state, and feedback semantics. LABO-050 is an internal improvement cycle with target-owner authority and post-change re-observation; it is only a weakly adjacent mapping. None requires a PM-01 dashboard, four-level selector, cross-project heat map, filtering, click-through, polling, or gate-fail presentation.
unresolved_screen_conditions: L1-L12 heat map with L0 charter anchor, assignment load/AI slot usage, expandable sub-doc details
phase/mode/status/drive filters, clicks to PM-02, and manual refresh trigger
30-second polling and gate-fail immediate update expectation
green/yellow/red/empty/loading display states and not-implemented historical consumer status

condition_comparison.preserved_meaning: Fixed pair records a 2.0 external-source path through provenance, LABO decomposition/comparison/experiment, and a BRAIN knowledge candidate boundary. It reflects a portion of source evaluation and owner separation. It does not define old skill inventory/disposition, preserving old skill value, typed selection/application, context-load/redundancy outcomes, dynamic supply, efficacy measures, staged migration, consumer transfer, rollback, or retirement. LABO 033/051 and BRAIN 026/027 are 2.0-scoped; they are not 1.0 prerequisites.
unresolved_skill_conditions: current-head inventory of skill/agent/command supply, origin, distribution, triggers, and consumers
reuse existing classification/disposition for mixed responsibility assets; preserve unknowns
schema/lifecycle/typed target applicability and prohibition on skill-granted authority
needed-only acquisition and context management; keep memory/continuation separate
local staged transfer, old protection retained until receipt, current consumers and rollback evidence before retirement
